About Launchpad

Start simple.
Make room for more.

You don’t need every answer before you begin. Sometimes, you just need somewhere to put the first idea.

Launchpad is an early workspace concept by Sean Farmer, created for CS651. It brings a few useful starting points into one calm, approachable space.

Explore a card, save an idea, and make a little progress. The workspace is a starting point that will grow as its purpose takes shape.

Explore the workspace

Simple by design

Clear navigation and familiar controls keep the focus on what you want to do.

Room to evolve

A flexible foundation means new ideas can find their place as the project develops.
